name.en: Fake trading platform promoted in a WhatsApp group

how.en: You are added to a friendly WhatsApp or Telegram group about stock tips, or even fishing or sport. A “professor” or expert promotes a trading platform and other members post profits. The platform shows trades and growing returns, but the data is fake. When you try to withdraw, you are asked for fees or taxes, and the money never comes back. Some scams let you withdraw a little first so you invest more.

text.en: You are added to a WhatsApp or Telegram group about stock tips or a hobby.
An “expert” promotes a platform and members post big, steady profits.
You are pressured to deposit quickly to secure returns.
To withdraw, you are asked to pay fees or taxes, and nothing comes back.
Good morning team! Professor Mark’s signal today returned 18%. New members can still join the VIP trading plan, deposit before 5pm to secure your spot: [link]

en: Invitations to investment or stock tips groups on messaging apps.
Guaranteed, high or unusually steady returns.
A crypto platform not on AUSTRAC’s register.
Fees, taxes or deposits needed before you can withdraw.
Don’t act on investment advice from social media or chat groups.
Check the platform on AUSTRAC’s register and search for warnings.
If you transferred money, contact your bank straight away.
